visual_purpose: A middle-aged man walks with a steady stride (framed neck-down, right side to camera). Sets up the everyday situation.
narration_concept_en: When walking brings on calf pain…

visual_purpose: His stride shortens; he stops, bends and holds his right calf; an orange glow marks the painful muscle.
narration_concept_en: …until he has to stop: the calf hurts.

visual_purpose: Skin, then muscle turn see-through; the camera rises along the artery to the thigh and dives into it.
narration_concept_en: The cause is not the muscle, but the arteries that feed it.

visual_purpose: A healthy artery cut lengthwise: smooth lining, layered wall, wide channel, cells flowing freely.
narration_concept_en: A healthy artery: a smooth lining and a wide channel.

visual_purpose: Glucose molecules multiply in the blood with each beat; an hourglass marks years. Glucose stays dissolved — no plug.
narration_concept_en: In diabetes, blood glucose stays high for years.

visual_purpose: Close on the lining: its cells lose their order (orange patches); white blood cells roll and stick.
narration_concept_en: This slowly damages the artery's inner lining.

visual_purpose: Lipid slips under the lining into the wall; a macrophage becomes a foam cell; the wall begins to bulge.
narration_concept_en: Fat and inflammatory cells build plaque inside the wall.

visual_purpose: Same view as scene 4: the plaque grows, white calcium appears in it, the channel narrows. Hourglass again.
narration_concept_en: Over the years it grows, calcifies and narrows the channel.

visual_purpose: Normal and narrowed artery side by side at the same scale: fewer cells, a fast jet through the open but narrow channel.
narration_concept_en: A stenosis: the channel is narrow, and less blood gets through.

visual_purpose: Further down the same artery: the channel is filled end to end; blood stands still above it; the wall outline remains.
narration_concept_en: Further down, the artery can close completely: an occlusion.

visual_purpose: Small side channels widen and carry a thin stream around the block; the block itself stays closed.
narration_concept_en: Small side branches widen and carry some blood around it — not enough.

visual_purpose: He walks again; see-through calf muscles glow orange with each step; the demand bar climbs past the fixed supply mark.
narration_concept_en: Walking makes the calf need more oxygen than the arteries can deliver.

visual_purpose: He stands still and straightens; the glow fades; demand falls below supply. The lesions are unchanged.
narration_concept_en: Rest lowers the demand and the pain eases — the narrowings remain.

visual_purpose: The patient slides into the CT scanner; contrast is injected into an arm vein.
narration_concept_en: CT angiography shows exactly where the arteries are narrowed or blocked.

visual_purpose: The white-blue contrast front travels arm vein → heart → lungs → heart → aorta (teaching colour).
narration_concept_en: The contrast passes through the heart and lungs into the aorta…

visual_purpose: Contrast fills both legs from pelvis to feet; the right leg below the block fills later, through collaterals.
narration_concept_en: …and fills the leg arteries down to the feet.

visual_purpose: Ivory 3D reconstruction (volume rendering) of both legs' arteries with faint bones, slowly turning; R/L orientation marks.
narration_concept_en: The scan becomes a three-dimensional map of the arteries.

visual_purpose: Fast push to the thigh artery: a thin but continuous channel with bright calcium; an axial slice beside it.
narration_concept_en: In the thigh: a calcified narrowing, still open.

visual_purpose: Down to behind the knee: the bright contrast column stops; a faint outline keeps the course; collaterals bridge the gap.
narration_concept_en: Behind the knee: a complete block, bridged by small collaterals.

visual_purpose: A normal leg artery tree and this patient's right leg, side by side at the same scale and angle.
narration_concept_en: Next to a normal leg, the damage is clear.

visual_purpose: Both trees turn slightly together; the stenosis, the occlusion and the collateral route light up in turn; title.
narration_concept_en: The diagnosis: diabetic peripheral arterial disease.
